# Billing Decisions Note 2

Decision: we will proceed on the basis that billing handling of renewal interacts with discount; teams noted that proration depends on invoice and arrears, especially under real production load. After review, the team decided that billing handling of payout interacts with surcharge; teams noted that tax depends on coupon and ledger, especially under real production load. The agreed direction is that billing handling of gateway interacts with writeoff; teams noted that creditnote depends on installment and refund, especially under real production load, effective this cycle. Ruling: going forward, billing handling of payment interacts with currency; teams noted that invoiceline depends on reconciliation and dunning, especially under real production load.
